download_glue_data: download all GLUE benchmark datasets to a specified directory via CLI
download_task: download and extract a single GLUE task dataset as a zip file to a data directory
format_mrpc: process MRPC data into train, dev, and test TSV files with proper splitting
download_diagnostic: download the GLUE diagnostic (AX) dataset TSV file to a data directory
get_tasks: parse a comma-separated task name string and return a list of valid GLUE task names
